# Local PDF dependency

- pdf-lib **1.17.1**, browser UMD bundle, copied unchanged from the configured
  bundled workspace runtime. Project: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib
- License: MIT, retained in `pdf-lib-LICENSE.md`.
- SHA-256 of `pdf-lib-1.17.1.min.js` (original binary file bytes):
  `0f9a5cad07941f0826586c94e089d89b918c46e5c17cf2d5a3c6f666e3bc694f`.
- Loaded locally, not from a CDN. It handles creation of downloadable planning
  PDF files; it does not perform API requests or hold user credentials.
